description.value: Honest to Pete Coffee Roasters is a Vancouver café and micro-roastery founded by Peter, who developed an air-roasting technique he credits with producing a smoother, richer cup with a smaller environmental footprint. The shop sells its own house roasts — including the flagship Retrospresso blend — alongside barista equipment and accessories, and offers local delivery as well as in-store pickup. A blog post titled 'Espresso on wheels' suggests some community connection to cycling culture.
